pr_title: Rebuild and merge context menu code
pr_body:
**Resolved / Related Issues**

Itemize resolved / related issues by this PR.
- Closes #2747
 
**Details of Changes**
This is still a work in progress.

#### Goals:
- Separate the context menu items from the MenuFlyout control (and UI in general) to make it easier to implement #2342 (and possibly #2780) in the future.
- Add code to allow for customization of items to make it easier to implement #3966


## ToDo:
- [x] Remove the ".Text" from the string resource keys, and use the localized strings
- [x] Add recycle bin items
- [x] Add the layout flyout
- [x] Clean up/remove old context menu code in BaseLayout
- [ ] Add pin to start commands (depends on #4218)
- [x] Implement IsChecked for the model
- [x] Move items that are only shown on shift to the more menu if shift isn't held 
- [x] Closes #4331 

**Validation**

How did you test these changes?
- [x] Built and ran the app
- [x] Tested the changes for accessibility

**Screenshots (optional)**

Add screenshots here.

issue_context.title: Code base: Merge context menus so they can be reused in different layouts
issue_context.body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
We currently reimplement the right click context menu in every layout. This leads to duplicate code and can make the context menu a little harder to work with.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
The context menus that are reused can be merged so that changes will only need to be made once.
comments: @d2dyno1 Yeah named something like that. It will be universal to all layout modes. We could also add the ability to add custom items to the flyout based on your layout mode later on, but this is a good start.
I have found that resource dictionaries can have code-behind files.
@duke7553 you were working on this? If not, @Jaiganeshkumaran would you like to be assigned on this?
Maybe #2342 could be included in this?
@winston-de This change should make #2342 a little easier to implement but they are two different changes and should be kept separate.
